terms.comment: Our family’s own word (the Libellus VII gloss: ārea lūsōria (ārea lūsōria: Traupman 53; lūsōrium: locūtiō nostra)), short for everyday use with the child.

phrases.english: Let’s run to the playground, Baba!

phrases.latin: lūsōrium autem, quod ante lūdum est, oscillīs et scālīs et tabulā dēclīvī īnstrūctum, semper patet
phrases.english: but the playground in front of the school, with its swings, ladders and slide, is always open

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 53, 361.
